runtimeMapping.normal: Single Arts ground/air start target, original .633 hit/maxAnimScale1, speed10 tracked projectile; union includes enemies blocked by own live dancers. Enemy damage precedes own injured-dancer healing in the local bridge.
runtimeMapping.trait: Any-source eligible ground death in current range queues its corpse tile after .1; recheck cap2/3/5 selected by promotion. Invalid placement is consumed, not moved. At cap trigger HealToken once.
runtimeMapping.token: Own phase/level interpolation without owner trust/potential/stat transfer; block1 Arts ground blocked target, .433 native Attack hit/maxAnimScale1; normal healFree. Single original skeleton aliased front/back; birth Start1s, no manual card,DP or occupied remaining slot.
runtimeMapping.heal: Own in-range injured dancer lowestHP-ratio selection; HealViaMaxHpRatio source live MAX_HP*hp_ratio1 with ignoreHealFree and skipModifierEvent. Direct HP restoration bypasses healing modifiers/hooks, while isolation/noHeal/untargetable remain gated.
runtimeMapping.s1: All10 ranks self ATK; owned dancers HP/DEF/block modifiers apply to existing/new tokens, remove with skill. Native .5 forceTick aura synchronization; no puppet ATK transfer, S1 restartFSMfalse preserves attack.
runtimeMapping.s2: All10 ranks self/token ASPD and host enlarged range; token Skill_2_Loop .5 native hit, Arts ground/air speed10 tracked; owner Skill_2_Loop .667. S2 mode changes cancel unfired attacks. At end snapshot surviving count, withdraw without kill, first rebuilt immediately then .1 attempts on nearest legal tiles with randomized tied distances. No cap refill for previously killed tokens.
runtimeMapping.cleanup: Owner death/retreat withdraws all dancers and cancels queued corpse/rebuild callbacks by deployment identity. Launched projectiles survive source withdrawal. No orphan, timed automatic respawn or new default skill fallback.

verificationLimits: Compiled NecromancerSelector class/host filtering, union cross-class sorting and postFilter16 ordering are unavailable. Local owner binding, enemy-first priority and lowestHP-ratio/deployment tie healing are explicit bounded choices, not recovered native execution.

Native HealViaMaxHpRatio _getMaxHpFromTarget=false is mapped to the ability source Tecno MAX_HP; compiled source indirection/action order and whether other native flags waive noHeal/isolation remain unverified.

Native death aura admission/assignment/queued tile verification cadence and body-root tile behavior are approximated by kill-time range/ground/visibility gates and rounded enemy position. Aura attaches across current host range; .1 queue uses the existing battle timer.

Native tile filter27/tileSort2 comparator, blacklist/advanced build checker and tie distances are compiled. Local rebuild uses nearest squared Euclidean distance, random ties, low deployable ground with pass/obstacle/down/occupancy guards. Corpses never fall back to a neighboring tile.

Native born-FSM transition completion is unavailable. Local Start clip1s blocks attacking but not blocking/damage; no invented birth invulnerability. Token S2 idle uses original clips, but native begin/end transition choreography is not reproduced.

Native attribute propagation, HP ratio rebasing, mode restart/cancel ordering, dead-source projectile eligibility, aura .5 boundaries and frame event order are not independently matched to game execution. The local engine handles HP ratio rebasing and owner cleanup.

Native particles/audio/material render passes, modules, environmental stage skills and exact game-frame parity remain unsupported. Projectile orbs use existing placeholder presentation; original skeleton/atlas/texture identities do not prove native effect rendering.
